From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>

Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stability Pact: Deliverables & Acceptance Timetable

Hi Amit —

Thanks for the productive kickoff earlier. As discussed, attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short risks summary (Implementation_Risks.pdf). High-level ask: please review milestones below and confirm owners / acceptance criteria so we can lock the go-live window.

Proposed milestones (dates are placeholders until we hear back on resource availability):
- Week 0 (Aug 16): Provision dedicated environment + onboarding access (owner: StableTech infra)
- Week 1 (Aug 23): Schema & ingest validation — Redwood ingest team / StableTech data owner
- Week 3 (Sep 06): Feature validation & integration tests (owner: StableTech engineering)
- Week 4 (Sep 13): UAT window begins (2 weeks) — acceptance criteria doc to be validated
- Target go-live: Sep 27 (post-UAT signoff)

Open items for you:
1) Confirm StableTech owners for the first three milestones (names + emails).
2) Clarify UAT acceptance criteria you require (we proposed: latency < 500ms p95, error rate < 0.5%, sample prompts pass accuracy checklist).
3) Any procurement/contract gating (SOW amendment or PO) that would block provisioning?

Next steps: if we get owners and acceptance criteria by EOD Wednesday (Aug 11), Karhtik will publish a final MAP and we’ll schedule weekly ops syncs (30 min) starting week of Aug 16.

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Implementation_Risks.pdf (brief)

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

—
Naomi Feldman
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Naomi —

Appreciate the clear plan and the files. Quick responses inline below.

Inline: 
> Proposed milestones (dates are placeholders)
- Week 0 (Aug 16): Provision dedicated environment + onboarding access — Confirmed. Owner: me (Amit) coordinating with Infra (Lena).
- Week 1 (Aug 23): Schema & ingest validation — Owner: Lena Kim (lena.kim@stabletech.io)
- Week 3 (Sep 06): Feature validation & integration tests — Owner: Rohit Singh (rohit.s@stabletech.io)
- Week 4 (Sep 13): UAT window begins (2 weeks) — We request a 3-week window if possible; we have stakeholder blackout from Sep 20–24.
- Target go-live: Sep 27 — Tentatively okay, subject to UAT length.

Questions / asks:
1) Acceptance criteria: can you capture the ‘sample prompt pass rate’ as a percentage and provide an example checklist? We prefer objective pass/fail checks.
2) Can Redwood provide a short rollback/playback plan for the first 48 hours of go-live? (We’ll need this for our change board.)
3) Procurement: we are finalizing PO and should have a purchase order before Aug 20. Will that timeline block provisioning?

Thanks — I’ve looped in Lena (infra) and Rohit (engineering) on ownership. We’ll aim to return a fully populated MAP by Aug 11 COB.

Best,
Amit

Thanks — quick update from the Redwood side after reviewing Amit’s responses. I’ve drafted an updated timeline in the shared Drive (link below) and included explicit owners and acceptance gates. Key changes:

- UAT window adjusted to 3 weeks as requested: Sep 13–Oct 03. This moves target go-live to Oct 04 unless we fast-track remediation during the UAT window.
- Acceptance gates we propose (will put in the MAP spreadsheet):
  * Gate 1 — Ingest validation: deterministic schema checks pass on 100% of sample files + ingest error rate < 0.2%
  * Gate 2 — Feature validation: 200 sample prompts across 5 categories with >= 90% pass rate on rubric
  * Gate 3 — UAT signoff: 10 business-scenario playbooks executed with documented results and a single stakeholder signoff from StableTech product owner

- Rollback/playback: we will provide a lightweight 48-hour runbook with actionables (toggle to previous model variant, cache invalidation steps, key metrics to watch, and contact escalation). Draft attached as a one-pager in the Drive.

On provisioning vs PO: we can provision the environment (sandbox/dedicated staging) ahead of PO for validation and testing. Production access (dedicated capacity behind SLOs) will require PO/SOW completion — we will not enable production traffic until procurement clears. That said, staging/canary validations can proceed.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz-stabletech-MAP

I’ll update MAP_v1.xlsx with the owners and gates and post MAP_v1.1 by EOD Wed (Aug 11).

—
Karthik Iyer

Attachments: final-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (MAP_v1.1)

Next steps (action owners):
